title: Object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector of [0.0, 0.0, 0.375]. Begin by drawing the first face, which consists of two concentric circles. The outer circle has a center at [0.021, 0.021] and a radius of 0.021, while the inner circle shares the same center but has a radius of 0.0188. After completing the first face, apply a scale factor of 0.042 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Next, transform the scaled 2D sketch into a 3D object by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and translating it using the vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.375]. To create the 3D model, extrude the sketch 0.1875 units in both the normal and opposite directions of the normal. This process forms a new solid body. The final object is named "Cylinder" and has a cylindrical shape with a flat top and bottom. The top surface is slightly wider than the bottom. The cylinder has a length and width of 0.042 units and a height of 0.375 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the center and radii of the circles
center = (0.021, 0.021)
radius_outer = 0.021
radius_inner = 0.0188

# Create the outer circle
r = r.center(center[0], center[1]).circle(radius_outer)

# Create the inner circle
r = r.circle(radius_inner)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
extrude_depth = 0.1875
r = r.extrude(extrude_depth, both=True)

# Translate the cylinder to the specified position
translation_vector = (0.0, 0.0, 0.375)
r = r.translate(translation_vector)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.021, 0.021)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.021)         # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.0188)        # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.1875, both=True)

# Translate the cylinder to the specified position
cylinder = cylinder.translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.375))

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Hollow tube made of two stacked segments
outer_r = 0.021
inner_r = 0.016
h_total = 0.375
h_seg = h_total / 2.0

# Segment 1 (lower half)
seg1 = (cq.Workplane("XY")
        .circle(outer_r)
        .circle(inner_r)
        .extrude(h_seg))

# Segment 2 (upper half)
seg2 = (cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0, 0, h_seg))
        .circle(outer_r)
        .circle(inner_r)
        .extrude(h_seg))

r = seg1.union(seg2)

import cadquery as cq

outer_r = 0.0210
inner_r = 0.0150
length = 0.3750
half = length / 2.0

outer = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(outer_r).extrude(half)
bore = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(inner_r).extrude(half + 0.002).translate((0, 0, -0.001))

lower = outer.cut(bore)
upper = lower.translate((0, 0, half))

r = cq.Compound.makeCompound([lower.val(), upper.val()])
